name: inventory-final

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();receipts=[]
for f in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 d=json.loads(f.read_text());receipts.append({'file':f.name,'exit':d['exit'],'killed':d['killed'],'wall_s':d['wall_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':d['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes']})
print(json.dumps(receipts,indent=2))
assert [r['file'] for r in receipts if r['exit']!=0]==['final-get.receipt.json']
assert not any(r['killed'] for r in receipts)
for n in ['source-map.json','review.json','NETWORK-STOP.json','read-access-inventory.json']:
 json.loads((p/n).read_text());print('valid JSON',n)
s=json.loads((p/'sources/search-one-full.json').read_text());print('full saved native response type/length',type(s).__name__,len(s));assert 'Restricted Matchings' in s and 'Glossary of graph theory' in s
r={'scope':'sampled telemetry only; native/transient/separate-writer/supervisor peaks unknown','receipts_observed':receipts,'remaining_terminal_records':'inventory-final.receipt/output, standalone frozen-after.json and seal-manifest receipt/output. Seal receipt/output excluded from terminal manifest and no others. Exhaustive receipt-inventory.json produced in seal step lists all already-completed receipts.','limits':{'affinity_max':2,'child_cpu_s':115,'supervisor_cpu_s':120,'address_space_GiB':6,'sampled_group_RSS_GiB':6,'deadline_s':130,'outer_timeout_s':140,'arena':2},'true_failure':'final-get exit1 guard rejection and logger failure, not repaired/reset','network':{'GET_hops':4,'transport_success_PDFs':2,'redirects':2,'rejected_HTTP_requests_dispatched':0,'search_calls':1,'queries':2},'frozen_before_count':33}
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'resource-inventory.json'],input=json.dumps(r,indent=2),capture_output=True,text=True);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
